line: His new fiancée walked into my cousin's wedding night,

description: Fiancée dancing in heels under party lights
line: twenty-five, dancing in her heels till the morning light.

description: Haldi: Neha struggles to sit on the floor, back pain
line: And me? I couldn't even sit down on the floor for the haldi.

description: Neha walks through decorated wedding entrance, head up
line: The only reason I held my head up through that shaadi

description: Neha at the parlour shutter, camera pushes into lit mirror
line: was what my parlour didi gave me just the week before. So let me take it back to the start.

description: Rooftop sunset: Neha and Rohan sit on ledge, Rohan smiles
line: Me and Rohan, six long years, never did get wed, "What's the hurry?" That's all he ever said. And I believed him. Gave that man my twenties whole,

description: Neha drives Rohan's mummy (knee brace) to physio
line: cooked, cleaned, drove his mummy to physio, played my role.

description: Neha hangs birthday bunting, Rohan on phone in doorway
line: Planned every birthday while he "needed space,"

description: Tanya selfie at the gym
line: and how'd he pay me back? Another girl in my place. Some girl named Tanya, twenty-four, from his gym.

description: Neha on bed reading phone, shocked, hand over mouth
line: Found out through a girl in my DMs, all about her and him: "Didi, I thought you should know."

description: Rohan leaves with suitcase down hallway; Neha alone
line: Three months later, he packed his bags to go.

description: Neha on floor among old photos, overhead pull-back
line: Four months on, I wasn't missing him anymore, I missed who I thought he was.

description: Neha in bed at night, neck/back pain glow
line: Mostly I was in pain, the kind no sleep could fix,

description: Neha at bathroom mirror, face in hands
line: thirty-two, but in the mirror I looked fifty, no tricks.

description: Neha at laptop, neck pain red glow
line: Ten-hour laptop days, my neck and back on fire,

description: Neha on stairs, knee pain glow
line: my knees cracked on the stairs, every day I felt more tired.

description: Yoga class, Neha struggles to stretch
line: I tried it all: physio, yoga at six a.m.,

description: Neha on bed with sprays/balms/heating pad (third-party brands visible)
line: the sprays, the balms, the heating pad, I bought every one of them.

description: Neha takes painkillers in kitchen, back pain glow
line: Painkillers till my stomach burned, the ache came right back.

description: Neha on bed, rain and lightning, head in hands
line: My body gave up on me the same way Rohan did, just like that.

description: Parlour: Meena didi behind Neha in salon chair (mirror)
line: Then I'm in Meena didi's chair,

description: Meena pours oil, combs hair (hair champi)
line: twelve years she's done my hair,

description: Meena presses Neha's shoulders, Neha in pain
line: mid-champi she presses my shoulders, and stops right there.

description: Neha cries in the chair, Meena comforts
line: "What's going on with you?" I broke down, right in that chair.

description: Meena pulls out the bottle, push-in to bottle close-up
line: From her drawer, she pulled out a bottle with herbs on it.

description: Meena talks, holds bottle beside Neha
line: "My client who's a physiotherapist put me onto this.

description: CGI herbs swirl into warm oil pot
line: Not those sprays, not the YouTube nuskhe, no, fifteen Ayurvedic herbs in warm til oil, it goes in deep and slow."

description: Neha arms crossed, bottle on counter, cut to bottle close-up
line: "Didi, I'm not spending more on something that does nothing."

description: Meena close-up, finger raised, promise
line: She looked me dead in the eyes: "If it doesn't work, your facials are free for a year."

description: Neha close-up, stunned
line: Twelve years, she never once said that.

description: Neha at bedside with bottle on nightstand, push-in to bottle
line: So I took it home, rubbed it in every night before bed.

description: Neha texting on bed, smiling
line: A week in, I texted her, "Why is this working?" I said,

description: Meena texting back in parlour
line: "when nothing else did?" And she wrote back: "Because it was never just your back.

description: X-ray back: muscles inflamed red
line: Ten hours at a desk and all that stress, your muscles stayed tight, inflamed, a mess.

description: CGI skin/muscle block, spray evaporating off the top
line: Sprays sit on the skin, an hour later they're gone,

description: CGI oil sinking through skin into muscle, glowing warm
line: warm oil massaged in slow gets down where it's wrong. No oil fixes your whole life, that's true,

description: Neha sleeping peacefully
line: but sleeping without pain is a good start for you."

description: Bottle reveal on Diwali table, push-in
line: It's called EIS Ayurvedic Pain Relief Oil,

description: Bottle with herbs, leaves falling
line: Mahanarayan, Nirgundi, Ashwagandha, in a warm til oil.

description: Neha stretches on bed, morning sun, joyful
line: Week one, I slept straight through the night. Week two, the morning stiffness started feeling light.

description: Neha walks up stairs easily
line: Week three, the stairs stopped scaring me.

description: Neha gets up at puja without holding wall
line: A month in, cross-legged at puja, I got up free, didn't even hold the wall.

description: Neha puts heels back on, smiles
line: Six weeks in, the heels back on, two years untouched, I walked tall.

description: Mirror morph: grey kurta to teal saree (before→after, one clip)
line: Not the old me. The me I was supposed to be.

description: Neha dancing in teal saree at Diwali
line: Next family Diwali party, first one on the floor,

description: Neha close-up, glowing, tucks hair
line: nothing extra, no filter, no painkiller anymore.

description: Rohan and Tanya arrive arm in arm
line: And there's Rohan. Tanya on his arm.

description: Neha sits for rangoli, gets up easily
line: The cousins call me for rangoli, I sit down, get up calm.

description: Rohan stunned close-up
line: Rohan's face changed, he couldn't move.

description: Rohan speaks, Neha walks past
line: "Wow, you look really good." "Thanks." And I kept it moving.

description: Tanya checks herself in phone camera
line: Tanya kept checking herself in her phone camera.

description: Neha laughing with cousins, sparklers
line: I wasn't checking for anybody.

description: Neha leaves phone on table, smiles
line: Rohan texted that night. Left him on read.

description: Neha smiles at herself in the mirror
line: But the moment wasn't him looking at me, it was me in the mirror, finally seeing me.

description: Neha in mirror, tears to smile
line: For years it said, "she's been through it." Now it says, "she's still here." I didn't need Rohan to see me. I needed to see me, clear.

description: Neha behind bottle, push-in to label (end card)
line: It's called EIS Ayurvedic Pain Relief Oil, rub it in every night. Nine ninety-nine.

description: Neha walks a sunny street
line: If long days and stress got you stuck inside your skin, you're not alone. Ease the pain tonight, let it begin.

line: Fifty percent off right now, cash on delivery, if the link below is still working, grab it before it's history.

description: Neha walks past Rohan and Tanya at the gate
line: One bottle. That's all it took for me. If Rohan notices next function, that's a bonus, see,

line: but it's not for him anymore. It's for me.
